links.outcome: Expert reviewer agreement with LLM problem extraction and taxonomy category labels on sampled reports
links.effect: 94% mean reviewer agreement on problem identification; 91.5% agreement on parent category labels and 83.3% on child category labels.
links.quote: The LLM had scores of 94% mean agreement among reviewers in identifying problems, and 91.5% and 83.3% agreement in assigning 'parent' and 'child' category labels, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to extract and categorise problems from patient safety event report narratives into a taxonomy with trend dashboards

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM (GPT-4o) for analyzing and categorizing free-text patient safety reports with expert validation and stakeholder interviews on implementation readiness, but it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
